title: Fix Python EDHOC credential COSE_Key and C_I msg1 encoding
description: Found during 6.8.9 cross-validation (2026-08-28): (1) python/src/lichen/crypto/edhoc.py credential CCS is {1:1,-1:1,-2:pk,-3:null} — crv=1 (Ed25519) with y:null is invalid for OKP keys; Rust uses {1:1,-1:6,-2:pk}. Comment claiming Python matches Rust is stale. (2) Python encodes C_I in msg1 as bstr 0x4100, violating RFC 9528 §3.3.2 compact-integer rule. Both feed the transcript so they change master_secret derivation. Fix both, regenerate edhoc.json + oscore_context_parity.json fixtures, align python/tests/crypto.
